title: Digit Sum Steps
statement: Replace a number by the sum of its digits again and again until a single digit remains. Report the final digit and how many replacements were made.
input_format: One line with a non-negative integer that may be very long.
output_format: Print two integers: the final single digit and the number of steps.
constraints: The number has between 1 and 100000 digits and no leading zeros (except the number 0 itself).
hints: The number may not fit in any integer type; read it as text.
The first digit sum of a 100000-digit number is at most 900000, which fits easily.
Repeat the digit sum on the new value until it has one digit, counting the steps.
